(569)༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/shangs lugs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mchod gtor 'bul ba dkyus ma tsam gyi lag len byed na/zlum gtor lnga'am gcig la thebs kyu bzha

tei:div.tei:p: shangs lugs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mchod gtor 'bul ba dkyus ma tsam gyi lag len byed na/ zlum gtor lnga'am gcig la thebs kyu bzhis mtshan pa bshams/ yi dam ltar byin brlabs la/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor dang*/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su gzhal med khang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su padma'i gdan lnga tshom/ dbus su zla ba la oṃ las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ zhi ba'i nyams ldan// shar du nyi ma la hūm̐ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro bo'i nyams ldan/ lho ru zla ba ser po la trāṃ las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ dgyes pa'i nyams ldan/ nub tu nyi ma dmar po zer dang bral ba la hrīḥlas padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ chags pa'i nyams ldan/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje la a las sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ khro zhing bzhad pa sogs nyams sna tshogs pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas cang te'u 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam pa lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings su gnas pa/ mchan khung g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭaṃ' ga la rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che padma ral gri rnams kyis mtshan pa/ 'od zer sna lnga 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ rang mtshungs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo 'bum 'bum dang 'khor mkha' 'gro grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med (570)pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs mtshams thams cad nas gtso mo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro lnga la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab cing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra ā ka ḍḍha ya/ ā kaḍḍha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ bandha ya/ bandha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī naṃ/ hṛ da yaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan lnga/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtor chog tsam la bzlas pa mi dgos kyang*/ spro na/ spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ swā āḥhā hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ trām̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥphaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ āḥphaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hoḥphaṭa/ zhes lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ rgyas par na tshigs bcad dang bcas pa dang*/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam (571)mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// padma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/

/ces de nyid lnga pas bstod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni bla med phyos// 'on kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skye// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab// yig brgya// bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu// bdag srung*// smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu rin 'byung las zur du bkol ba ste gu ṇas so/// /dge legs 'phel/// / (572)
